start: Members page (menu: Members), signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: Title "Members" with "{n} members" under it; buttons "+ Add member" and "Import from Excel"; tabs "All members" and "Joined in the app"
must_not: A count that differs from the rows in the list

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member" with "Full name", "Code", "Mobile number", "Joining date" and optional boxes
must_not: The form opening with another member's values in it

steps.action: Type a full name and a 10-digit mobile number, leave the rest
user_sees: Hint "Used to find them, and to send them WhatsApp messages."
must_not: Any optional box (email, date of birth, address) being required

steps.action: Tap "Add member"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…", the sheet closes, the new member is in the list and the count is one higher
must_not: Two members made from one tap; a member saved with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap the new member
user_sees: Member page: the name as title, "Member since {day}", buttons "Edit" and "Sell membership", "No memberships yet"
must_not: "Collect payment" shown when nothing is due; "Renew" shown for a member who never had a plan

steps.action: Tap the quick button "New member" on Today
user_sees: The Members page with the "Add member" sheet already open
must_not: The plain list with no form; the form opening twice

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: The sheet closes; the Members list stays, nothing added
must_not: An empty member saved

start: Today, a home tile such as fees due or plans ending (address /members/f/<tile>)

steps.action: Tap the tile on Today
user_sees: The Members list already narrowed to the same people the tile counted
must_not: A list whose length differs from the number on the tile

steps.action: Tap a member in the list
user_sees: That member's page
must_not: Another member's page

steps.action: Type an unknown address /members/<wrong id>
user_sees: "Member not found" and the button "Back to members"
must_not: A blank page or an endless spinner

start: Members, tab "Joined in the app" (address /members/app); the other kind of member: one who joined from the phone app

steps.action: Tap "Joined in the app"
user_sees: Subtitle "Who has the MettleUp app on their phone"; the list of app members, or "Nobody has joined in the app yet"; "+ Add member" is not shown here
must_not: "Loading…" that never ends; a member of another gym in the list

steps.action: Look at numbers waiting to be confirmed (a member typed a phone number in the app)
user_sees: Each waiting number with the member it would be joined to and a way to confirm or refuse (exact words not read)
must_not: A number joined to a list member with nobody at the desk confirming it

start: A member's page, button "Member card" (the ID card to print or share)

steps.action: Open a member, tap "Member card"
user_sees: A sheet with the member's card: name, photo or initials, the gym name (exact words not read)
must_not: Another member's photo or another gym's logo on the card

steps.action: Print or share the card
user_sees: The browser print or share sheet with the same card
must_not: A blank printed page; the card cut off at the paper edge

steps.action: Tap "Add member" with every box empty
user_sees: "Type the member’s name." and "Type their mobile number." marked on the boxes; the first wrong box scrolls into view
must_not: A member saved with no name; only one of the two boxes marked

steps.action: Type a mobile number with 7 digits, tap "Add member"
user_sees: "This mobile number looks wrong. Check it and type it again."
must_not: The short number saved

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a member already in the list, tap "Add member"
user_sees: On the mobile box: "{name} already has this mobile number in Members."
must_not: A second member with the same mobile number saved while online

steps.action: Type the mobile number of an archived member
user_sees: A message that names the archived member, so the clash can be solved (exact words not read)
must_not: "Number taken" by someone who cannot be found anywhere

steps.action: Type a name of more than the allowed letters
user_sees: "The name can be at most {max} letters."
must_not: The name saved cut short without a word

steps.action: Tap "Archive member"
user_sees: Notice "Member archived."; the pill "Archived" on the page; the button now reads "Restore member"
must_not: The member's payments, visits or memberships deleted

steps.action: Go back to Members
user_sees: The archived member is no longer in the list and the count is one lower
must_not: The archived member still counted in "{n} members"

steps.action: Open the archived member again (old link), tap "Restore member"
user_sees: The pill "Archived" goes; the member is back in the list with the same plan and dues as before
must_not: A restored member with a changed end date or lost dues

steps.action: Tap "Edit", change the mobile number, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The new number on the page under "Mobile"
must_not: An edit that silently un-archives or archives the member

start: A member's page with the desk photo button (only when the gym's server keeps photos)

steps.action: Tap the photo button under the avatar and take a photo with the desk computer's camera
user_sees: The camera preview, then the saved photo exactly as the preview showed it
must_not: A flipped photo; the photo saved before the person at the desk confirms it

steps.action: Open the same member on another signed-in device of this gym
user_sees: The same photo
must_not: The photo opening for someone not signed in to this gym, or in another gym

steps.action: Sign in as a member in the phone app and look for the desk notes
user_sees: The member never sees the gym's "Notes" about them
must_not: Desk notes or another member's details shown in the member app
